title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
abstract: arXiv:2610.04433v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A coding agent is a language model inside a harness: the system prompt, the tools, and the context management that let a chat model work in a repository. Most of the engineering on these agents goes into the harness, and vendors and leaderboards credit it with score gains. Earlier studies have fixed the model and swapped the harness, but have not measured whether the swap changes the pass rate more than running the same harness again. We run seven models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified and two benchmarks of other kinds, and rerun them unchanged. No harness leads consistently across models. Where the data can bound the difference between two harnesses, the bound is 2 to 5 points, and a harness swap changes about as many task outcomes as a rerun. The exceptions are harness effects in particular pairings of model and harness, whose direction changes with the model: Ope

translated_title: 框架到底换来了什么？主要只是更多的 Token
translated_abstract: 编码智能体是运行在框架中的语言模型：框架包括系统提示词、工具以及让聊天模型能够在代码仓库中工作的上下文管理。这些智能体的大部分工程投入都集中在框架上，厂商和排行榜也将分数提升归功于框架。早期的研究固定模型并更换框架，但并未测量这种更换对通过率的改变是否大于用同一框架重新运行一遍。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 以及另外两个不同类型的基准上，用三个生产级框架——Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent 和 OpenCode——运行七个模型，并在完全相同的条件下重新运行。结果显示，没有任何一个框架能在所有模型上保持一致领先。在数据能够界定两个框架差异的地方，该差异的上界为 2 到 5 个百分点，而更换框架所改变的任务结果数量与重新运行一次大致相当。例外情况是特定模型与框架配对中出现的框架效应，其影响方向随模型而变化：Ope
tldr: 该研究通过对七个模型在三个生产级框架和多个基准上的重复对照实验发现，没有任何框架能稳定提升性能，更换框架带来的差异仅有 2 到 5 个百分点、效果与重新运行一次相当，框架带来的分数提升主要源于更多的 token 消耗。
en_tdlr: Through rerun-controlled experiments of seven models across three production harnesses on multiple benchmarks, this paper finds that no harness consistently leads, that harness differences are bounded at 2–5 points and matter about as much as a rerun, and that what a harness buys is mostly tokens.
